findings.title: Implicit sole-security selection bypasses the listing validity check
findings.observed: Explicit security_id goes through listingActiveAt; omitted/null with exactly one security automatically assigns it after that check. A retired listing with valid_to2021 was selected at2026-10-28.
findings.expected: Explicit and implicit selections use the same effective-security validity check; any clear refusal is acceptable.

findings.title: Different rows dispatch concurrent mutations despite global inFlightRowId
findings.observed: A deferred first apply was positively entered; invoking confirm on another row called the transport a second time before releasing the first. The second row overwrote the global inFlightRowId.
findings.expected: Global serialization/refusal or safe queueing across all rows, not only same-row double-click.
findings.usual_UI_reachable: Normal mount event guard prevents the common path; exported machine and getMachine host surface remain vulnerable.

findings.title: A new upload replaces the draft while its prior mutation is still pending
findings.observed: During a positively-entered deferred apply, loadUpload returned and changed the source file hash before the old apply was released; its ACK ownership was detached from the current draft.
findings.expected: Refuse or safely queue replacement until pending mutation ownership is settled; no forced error-code vocabulary. Adjacent host loadDraft/dispose cases also need regression coverage.
findings.usual_UI_reachable: Common file-input path has view.busy guard; exported machine/host surface still needs the invariant.

findings.title: unknown can be reset and re-POSTed without inspecting original state
findings.observed: First apply timed out and produced unknown; resolveRow then select/preview/confirm issued a second apply while inspectMember call count remained0.
findings.expected: Keep uncertain write ownership across resolve/reselect/repreview and stop further writes until original state reconciliation, without automatic or reset-mediated retry.

findings.title: A delayed preview for candidateA attaches to selected candidateB
findings.observed: While A preview was deferred, selection changed to B. A reply then set preview_ready on the same row with A preview request/token while selected_entity_id stayed B.
findings.expected: Bind async replies to draft/row/selection epoch, discard stale replies or reject conflicting edits. This proves UI token/selection mismatch only, not an incorrect real-owner write.
findings.usual_UI_reachable: Ordinary guarded UI events serialize; direct exported machine/host surface exposes the race.

grouping: Three repair roots: shared effective listing selection; whole-draft write ownership/uncertainty; async draft/row/selection epoch. One consolidated R1, not five cards.
